import numpy as np, collections
a=np.array(G['Demo pair 2 input'])
def frags(color):
    # sep rows/cols where all==2
    sr=[r for r in range(len(a)) if np.all(a[r]==2)]
    sc=[c for c in range(len(a[0])) if np.all(a[:,c]==2)]

    cb=[(-1,sc[0]),(sc[0]+1,sc[1]),(sc[1]+1,sc[2]),(sc[2]+1,None)]

    for bi,(r0,r1) in enumerate(rb):
        for bj,(c0,c1) in enumerate(cb):

    return F
for col in [1,3]:
